name: What affects the cost of framing a small addition?
description: Main cost drivers are size, materials, roof changes, labor, and structural complexity. Tight tie-ins and load-bearing changes usually cost more.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of framing a small addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on square footage, lumber or steel needs, roof changes, labor, and whether the project includes structural upgrades. Small additions often cost less than major expansions, but tight tie-ins, custom roof lines, and load-bearing changes can raise the framing budget quickly.
